# Label configuration for spinq-vqe
# Pastel color scheme matching the project aesthetic

- name: bug
  color: E8A598
  description: Something isn't working

- name: enhancement
  color: B8B8E8
  description: New feature or improvement

- name: good first issue
  color: C7E4CA
  description: Friendly for newcomers

- name: help wanted
  color: F0D9CC
  description: Extra attention needed

- name: science
  color: D4C5F9
  description: Scientific content, methods, or results

- name: discussion
  color: C5DFF9
  description: Open discussion topic

- name: documentation
  color: F9E8C5
  description: Docs, README, comments

- name: testing
  color: C5F9E8
  description: Tests, CI, validation

- name: performance
  color: F9C5D4
  description: Speed, memory, optimization

- name: qaoa
  color: E8C5F9
  description: QAOA-related work

- name: vqe
  color: C5E8F9
  description: VQE-related work

- name: kagome
  color: F9D4C5
  description: Kagome lattice physics

- name: entanglement
  color: D4F9C5
  description: Entanglement metrics, entropy
